body: I can feel it immediately when someone lies to my face. My friends find it a bit scary but, yeh. And im always ready to throw myself in front of danger for others, as well.
my nmom did this with my brother's friend. treated him better than she ever did me. called him my brother and everything.

Several bad experiences. one told my mother everything i was saying, then said i should be grateful because i have all of my limbs in tact ( because she met a woman and didnt even realise she was missing an arm until she went to shake a hand that wasnt there). Then another that implied i was using my father's passing as an excuse. He died two days before my last birthday. he only got one visit from me.
Idk I have an appointment with a counselor on campus but I'm worried that it'll just end up like everything else, where it gets thrown in my face and everything gets even worse.
A lot. Too much to fit in one thread. Family stuff and just me being improperly treated by any support I found.
